findings.title: `lib/drive.sh`'s header contract ("pure library… spawns nothing", "source AFTER lib/manifest.sh … lib/hooks.sh") is now false for `libexec/orchid-verify`, which sources it after only `common.sh`/`frontmatter.sh` and reaches a path that executes `handoff.pin_check`; it works only because the prestate entry point happens not to call the other libraries.
